title: Splendor in the Sand Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Splendor in the Sand is a well-appointed 3-bedroom/3.5 bath home, conveniently located near the Seaside Adult and Family Pools and the Fitness Center. On the first floor, there is a large den, a king bedroom with a private bath, as well as a bedroom with two sets of bunk beds and a private bath.
description_expanded: Description40 VENICE CIRCLE2 KINGS, BUNK ROOM (1 Queen and 2 twins, sleeps 4) FULL MURPHY BED, QUEEN SLEEPER SOFA. (Sleeping capacity for 10)Prime Location in the Heart of Seaside, FloridaProfessionally designed and recently renovated, Splendor in the Sand is a luxury Seaside cottage ideally located just three blocks from Seaside’s iconic white-sand beaches. Nestled in one of the most desirable areas of town, this home sits steps from the shaded family and adult pools, children’s playground, tennis courts, croquet lawn, and the Seaside fitness center—placing the very best of Seaside, Florida right outside your door.Sophisticated Coastal Living & Entertaining SpacesThis beautifully appointed 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath luxury cottage offers two spacious living areas designed for both relaxation and gathering. The heart of the home is the pristine chef’s kitchen, featuring a Viking gas range, a custom built-in refrigerator, abundant storage, and a stunning marble island with seating for seven—perfect for entertaining family and friends. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the main living area, highlighted by beamed ceilings, a designer sectional, smart TV, and thoughtfully selected window treatments that enhance the home’s light-filled coastal charm.Private Suites Designed for Comfort & FlexibilitySplendor in the Sand features two king primary suites, each outfitted with Peacock Alley linens and spa-inspired, fully renovated ensuite bathrooms. The upstairs primary suite also includes a full-size Murphy bed for additional guests and a convenient full-size washer and dryer. The third bedroom is ideal for families, offering a custom built-in queen bed, two bunk beds, and a beautifully updated ensuite bathroom with a new tub and shower combination.Inviting Outdoor Living & Seaside LifestyleAn outdoor living space just off the kitchen provides a relaxed setting for alfresco dining, complete with a new gas grill and a high-top table with seating. Start your mornings rocking on the charming front porch, spend your afternoons biking through Seaside’s picturesque streets, and enjoy evenings at the Seaside Amphitheater or unwinding on Seaside’s private residential beach.An Ideal Seaside Family GetawayWith its unbeatable location, luxury finishes, flexible sleeping arrangements, and seamless access to Seaside’s world-class amenities, Splendor in the Sand offers the perfect setting for a memorable family vacation in Seaside, Florida—where coastal elegance meets effortless comfort.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break & Summer; 3-night Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration.FEATURES2,308 square feetSeaside Private Residential Beach at Tupelo Pavilion; Seaside is the largest private residential beach on 30A5-minute, 352-yard walk to beach accessAs featured in the Southern Living Summit for Seaside, FloridaTwo KING primary bedrooms with private ensuite bathroomsAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes included for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homes; a golf cart is considered a car and requires a special permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002379
